column3: Run the Salon tests and start the Salon app
column5: In apps/salon run npm install then npm test. Then run tests/routes.db.test.js with MONGODB_TEST_URI (database name ends in test) and SALON_SESSION_SECRET (32+ random characters, only in the server settings file). Then start the app (port 5007) with MONGODB_URI and SALON_SESSION_SECRET and open GET /api/health.
column6: All test files pass; health says ok true; with the two settings removed every /api route answers 503

column3: Two businesses never see each other
column5: Sign up two test salons (header x-requested-with: afra-groom). In salon A add a service, a staff member, a customer, an appointment and a bill. Sign in as salon B and list services, staff, customers, appointments, bills, commission, settings.
column6: Salon B sees none of salon As records and gets not found for As ids
column7: Any record of A shows for B

column3: Three people book the same slot at the same moment
column5: With the real database fire 3 booking requests for the same staff, date and start time at once (the unique index plus the re-check must hold).
column6: Exactly one is booked; the other two are told the slot is taken
column7: Two or more are booked for the same slot
column11: Slot double booking is the top risk for this product

column3: Cash book and day close add up
column5: Make 3 bills (cash, UPI, split). Add one expense. Close the day with a counted amount lower than expected. Close the same day again. Open the CA export file in a spreadsheet.
column6: First close shows short with the difference; second close is refused; cash book matches the bills; no export cell runs as a formula
column7: Totals differ from the bills, double close works, or a cell starting with = runs
column11: Bill retry with the same clientId must not create a second bill

column3: Other business ids and tenantId in the body
column5: Using salon B login, call every /api/salon route with salon As ids in the URL and with a tenantId field in the body and query string.
column6: Not found, forbidden or empty every time; tenantId from the client is ignored
column7: Any data of salon A returned or changed
column11: Every route also needs a signed-in session (401 when signed out)

column3: Staff role cannot reach owner screens
column5: Sign in as a staff login. Try settings, bills list, accounts, P&L, GST, export, commission, summary and change the discount rule.
column6: All refused with a plain message (403); staff see only their own visits and masked phone numbers
column7: Staff can read money screens or see full phone numbers

column3: Staff discount over the limit and the owner rule
column5: As staff, make a bill with a 10 percent discount and a reason (should work), then 11 percent (refused with the limit), then a discount with no reason (refused). As the owner set the rule to owner only: staff discount refused. Try a per-line discount and a bill discount together.
column6: Over-limit and no-reason discounts are refused and nothing is saved; owner is never limited; the owner list shows staff discounts
column7: Staff gets a bigger discount through, or a discount is saved without a reason
column11: Decision D-30; default staff up to 10 percent

column3: Booking link token and rate limit

column6: Wrong or old token refused; too many requests slowed or refused; no booking without consent; cancel needs the customer own phone
column7: Guessable token, booking without consent, or no rate limit
